in_sanskrit.name: अर्जन
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: अर् (ar) - ruler, जन (jan) - people; Arjan is a name meaning 'ruler of the people'.

in_hindi.name: अर्जन
in_hindi.meaning: राजा (raja) - king, जननिवास (janivasa) - inhabitant; Arjan can be interpreted as 'king of the inhabitants' or 'ruler of the people'.

in_tamil.name: அர்ஜன்
in_tamil.meaning: அரசன் (arasan) - king, ஜனன் (janan) - people; Arjan is a Tamil name meaning 'king of the people'.

in_telugu.name: అర్జన్
in_telugu.meaning: రాజయ్ (raju) - king, జనముదు (janamudu) - people; Arjan is a Telugu name meaning 'king of the people'.

in_marathi.name: Arjan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Arjan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Arjan is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘arjana’, meaning ‘just’, ‘righteous’, or ‘clear’. In Hindu mythology, Arjuna is a renowned warrior and one of the greatest heroes in the Mahabharata, known for his bravery and devotion to his dharma.
